svg.text: Battery supply, voltage sensing and native USB
2 × AAA alkaline in series / reverse polarity protection and 3.3 V boost
Use X5R/X7R ceramics. Put C1–C4 close to U1 and keep the SW copper small. Route FB away from SW.
FIT all parts above. Enable link R18 is shown below.
FIT C5–C7: 1 nF + (1 nF in series with 1 nF) = 1.5 nF across R1.
Battery ADC / 1:1 divider matches the firmware
BAT_ADC = BAT_SYS / 2. Use 1% resistors; 15 µA at 3.0 V.
Mark pin 1 on both PCB and fixture. Place R5 and R6 near U2.
JP1 / select exactly one power source
2 SYS_3V3 • to U2, keypad, LED and MPU
FIT 1–2 for batteries. Programming then uses D+, D− and GND.
2–3 for fixture 3.3 V (≥500 mA); remove the 1–2 bridge first.
USB VBUS is 5 V. Never connect VBUS to J1 pin 3.
Power links and reserve parts / no user power switch
Remove R17 and bridge its pads with an ammeter to measure battery current.
C17: DNP, 1206 ceramic footprint from BAT_SYS to GND, near C1/C2.
TP9 BAT_RAW • TP10 BAT_PROT • TP11 BAT_SYS • TP12 VBOOST
TP13 BOOST_EN • TP14 BAT_ADC • TP15 FIX_3V3 • TP16 GND
USB protection / tuning footprints / DNP initially
D11/D12: PESD3V3U1UA, SOD323; cathode to USB, anode to GND.
Reserve near J1. Use this low-capacitance type; do not use 1N4007.
C18: USB_DP → GND. C19: USB_DM → GND. Both 0603, DNP.
Keep C18/C19 near U2. Values require USB signal testing if fitted.
Route D+/D− together over continuous ground; keep branches short.
No 5 V connection and no charging circuit for the AAA cells.
Rev C • 23 Nov 2026 • ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module • Same net names connect • FIT = install; DNP = leave empty
